introduction: Billy Turner is a workaholic who lost his marriage and a lot of quality time with his kids to his job and the constant travel it requires. After his ex-wife Alicia moves to Atlanta and gets engaged to Chris, they invite the whole family to come spend Christmas (which is also her birthday) with her. Their kids, James and Haley, jump on the idea immediately which makes Billy hate it even more. For the love of his kids, he goes to Atlanta expecting the Worst Christmas Ever only to meet high powered lawyer, Harmony Davis with what could be his second chance at love. With a little holiday magic, new loves will be revealed and discovered while old hurts will be healed and forgiven.
